rows.en: Not ready, you say? At this late stage?
Are you ready now? I shall begin the final match, then?
And you, Zamsha?
Naturally.
Very well... Then... we shall now begin...
The Regis Fight, Final Match!!
Readyyyyyyy...!!! GOOOOOOOOOOO!!!
You did it!
...We did it.
Heh, we did it...
...We won.
...We won.
...We did it.
...We did it, all right!
We diiid it...!!
We did it!!
We did it!!
...We won.
...We did it.
...We did it.
...We did it.
...We did it.
...I-I am defeated. Yet why did I...?
We're always fighting to protect something. Zamsha, do you understand that?
We're always fighting to protect something. Zamsha, do you get that?
We're always fighting to protect something. Zamsha, do you understand that?
We're always fighting to protect something. Zamsha, do you understand that?
We fight to protect something, you know. Zamsha, do you get that?
We fight to protect something. Zamsha, do you get that?
Listen, we fight 'cause there's stuff we wanna protect. Zamsha... you get that?
We fight to protect something. Zamsha, do you get that?
We fight to protect something. Zamsha, do you get that?
We're always fighting to protect something. Zamsha, do you get that?
We're always fighting to protect something. Zamsha, do you get that?
We're always fighting to protect something. Zamsha, do you get that?
We're always fighting to protect something. Zamsha, do you get that?
We're always fighting to protect something. Zamsha, do you get that?
To protect... something...
That's right.
That's right.
That's right.
That's right.
That's right.
That's right.
That's right.
That's right.
That's right.
That's right.
That's right.
That's right.
That's right.
That's right.
...I have nothing to protect.
I shall attain the greatest power in the universe by my own strength...
...Right. Now all that's left is Taro.
Heroes, one and all, that was a splendid fight!
We've won the tournament. We'll ask you to stand aside.
We've won the tournament. Now stand aside.
We've won the tournament. Please, stand aside.
We won. Get out of the way.
We won. Get out of the way.
We've won the tournament! Now stand aside.
We won. Get out of the way.
We've won the tournament. Now stand aside.
We've won the tournament. Now stand aside.
We've won the tournament! Now stand aside!
We've won the tournament! Now stand aside!
All right! We won the whole tournament!! So get outta our way, pronto!
We've won the tournament. Now stand aside, Master Gundam.
We've won the tournament. Now stand aside, Master Gundam.
The winner's the king of this Cube, right!? Then that's an order!! Move!!
You lot, kings? Don't make me laugh!! What utter nonsense!!
I used this tournament to seek the one best suited as the Devil Gundam's Life Core...
In other words, I was judging who possessed a mighty body and an iron will.
What did you say...!?
What...!?
What...!?
What...!?

notes.note: Unlabelled-adjacent prompt follow-ups: #0.124 = Master Gundam after the player answers No to the ready prompt (cf. story_071 #0.110). #0.126 unlabelled = Master Gundam repeating the Yes/No prompt.
No brackets around the tournament name in the source here, so no quotes added (story_082 practice).
Gundam Fight-style 'Ready... Go!' call; stretched to match the longer source, cf. story_071 #0.107.
Ankh to the leader after the win; 'yatta na' rendered 'You did it!' (could also be 'We did it!').

#0.138-151, #0.153-166, #0.168-181: 14-slot leader blocks. Preceding Pt_Chara_Check chain (ids 14,15,12,11,5,4,3,2,1,8,6,7,10,9) gives Mebius, Zero, Seven, Ultraman, OOO, W, Den-O, RX, Rider 1, God Gundam, Nu, Zeta, 00, Wing Zero; wording fits (boku = Mebius #0.153, watashi = Seven/Ultraman #0.155-156, rough 'omee' = Momotaros #0.159). Identical Japanese kept identical; subject 'we' restored.
Zamsha: the unfinished 'why did I...?' (why he lost) kept as a trailing question.
Pronoun-only differences (ore vs boku/watashi) shown as 'get that' vs 'understand that'; rows without 'tsune ni' (always) dropped 'always'.
Unlabelled silence after Zamsha exits; likely the party.

#0.188-201 labelled Rider 1 by the extractor but are 14 leader variants (Rider 1 name = leader placeholder). Voiced by wording: 'moraou' composed, 'kure' polite (Mebius-like), 'doke' curt, boku with '!' (#0.193), watashi (#0.195-196, likely Seven/Ultraman), 'yossha... morau ze' = Momotaros (#0.199).
Not on the traced script path (branch between #0.201 and #0.223); unlabelled. Rough wording and the parallel Ankh line at #0.224 suggest Ankh. #0.203-205 = Master Gundam.
Sentence cut across #0.204/#0.205; English cut at the matching point. 'Seitai unit' rendered 'biological unit' (not in glossary; Devil Gundam core-host term).
Start of a 14-slot 'What...!?' leader block that continues into story_088 (#0.206-219).

report: All 80 rows translated. Uncertain: #0.137 Ankh's 'yatta na' read as 'You did it!'; #0.202 speaker inferred as Ankh (off traced path); #0.188-201 variant slots voiced by wording (labelled Rider 1). Not in glossary: Devil Gundam 'seitai unit' rendered 'biological unit'.
